All scheduled talks and plenary sessions will be held in lecture hall **W1019**.
Four nearby seminar rooms (W1020, W1021, W1023 and W1024) will host the breakout sessions. The **foyer of
Building W** will serve as the catering area for lunch and coffee breaks. If you need a quiet place
for a call or a meeting during the workshop, a separate room will be available for that
purpose.

See [Venue](venue.qmd) for maps and directions.

## Session types

The programme combines an invited keynote, contributed presentations, and collaborative breakout
sessions:

* The <span class="slotcat plenary">**Keynote**</span> has a 45-minute slot and sets the stage for the
  workshop.
* <span class="slotcat contributed">**Presentations**</span> are contributed talks of 15 minutes plus 5 minutes
  for questions.
* <span class="slotcat handson">**Breakout sessions**</span> are the core of the workshop. They run in
  four parallel tracks, one per [research direction](index.qmd), with the goal of critically
  assessing progress since the original priority research directions and identifying open
  challenges. The track overview introduces the four tracks, and participants sign up for the track
  they would like to join.
* <span class="slotcat oneidea">**Presentation of breakout findings**</span> brings the groups back
  together to report their results to all participants.
* <span class="slotcat open">**Organisational and collaborative slots**</span> — track overview,
  track sign-up, status sync, final result preparation, and the evening event — are used to
  coordinate between the groups and to prepare the joint outcome of the workshop.

The findings collected during the breakout sessions form the basis of the [joint scientific article](publication.qmd)
that will be prepared after the workshop.
